{{Recipe}}

'''Sese plantains''' is a delicious and popular meal eaten in Cameroon. It is very easy to prepare.

== Ingredients ==

* 3 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] [[Cookbook:Goat|goat]] meat or [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]]
* 2 medium-size [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 5 pounds unripe [[Cookbook:Plantain|plantains]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Ground Crayfish|ground crayfish]]
* 1 cup red [[Cookbook:Palm Oil|palm oil]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] chicken-flavour bouillon cube or powder
* 1 tablespoon powdered [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]] (optional)
* 1 bunch of fresh [[Cookbook:Kale|kale]] leaves, chopped
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste

== Procedure ==

# Cut the ends off the plantains. Make a shallow slit through the length of the peel, and remove it.
# [[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] the plantains into thick rounds.
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the meat in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] with salt, cayenne pepper, half the onions, and bouillon cubes until tender.
# Add the plantain, crayfish, red oil, and remaining onions. [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] for about 15–20 minutes.
# Stir in the kale, and cook for an additional 8 minutes.
# Remove from the heat and serve warm.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If you want to speed the cooking process, you can use a pressure cooker.
